svg.title: v9 five-channel neuron activation trace
svg.desc: Beginner-readable overview of the strongest neuron activations for fast, slow, control, message, and carrier channels. Blue cells are positive activations, red cells are negative activations, and darker cells are quiet.
svg.text: Each channel shows its 4 loudest neurons. Read left to right as time passes.
Berlin scientific colors: blue pushes up, red pushes down, dark means quiet.
This is an overview, not every neuron. Full trace: seed=94, hidden=16, steps=64; display scale +/-12.49, true max |activation|=25.20
